notes: The Danish Entrepreneur Festival figure (2,100) refers to the 2024 event; the Company Programme figure (1,500) covers school year 2024/2025. E3 counts once under Community and once under Entrepreneurship, because it independently meets both themes' criteria. Employee resource groups have no membership figures, and the statement that they 'will be included as sounding boards' for DE&I action plans is planned, not current. The Danske Bank Internationals Community (Danish lessons, culture fair) is covered within E8 to avoid double counting. Several items are not counted as cross-cultural evidence: HSB Bospar (approximately 120,000 savers), public-housing lending (DKK 105 billion), ARA loans, first-time-buyer offers, and basic payment accounts, which are regulatory. These are treated as general financial inclusion and housing finance, not cultural or underserved-community access programmes. Gender-balance targets and pay-gap data are demographic disclosures. Mandatory compliance training is not counted. The arms and defence position statement and lending to defence-sector customers show financing, not weapons manufacturing.
